description: Rotamer-relief comparison: whether the pocket-blocking side chains of SDF-9, IA-2, IA-2beta, STYX and apo PTP1B can swing clear of a bound phosphotyrosine
code:
import requests, numpy as np, itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    res={};order=[];het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; nm=L[12:16].strip()
        if len(L)>=78 and L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=int(L[22:26])
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{}}; order.append(k)
            res[k]['atoms'][nm]=x
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),nm,x))
    return dict(res=res,order=order,het=het)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt,pc,qc
def rot(A,B,ang,pts):
    k=B-A; k=k/np.linalg.norm(k); c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
    v=pts-B
    return B+v*c+np.cross(k,v)*s+np.outer(v@k,k)*(1-c)
SC={'ARG':['CB','CG','CD','NE','CZ','NH1','NH2'],'LYS':['CB','CG','CD','CE','NZ'],
    'GLU':['CB','CG','CD','OE1','OE2'],'GLN':['CB','CG','CD','OE1','NE2'],
    'ASP':['CB','CG','OD1','OD2'],'ASN':['CB','CG','OD1','ND2'],'MET':['CB','CG','SD','CE'],
    'LEU':['CB','CG','CD1','CD2'],'ILE':['CB','CG1','CG2','CD1'],'HIS':['CB','CG','ND1','CD2','CE1','NE2'],
    'PHE':['CB','CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ'],'TYR':['CB','CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ','OH'],
    'TRP':['CB','CG','CD1','CD2','NE1','CE2','CE3','CZ2','CZ3','CH2'],
    'SER':['CB','OG'],'THR':['CB','OG1','CG2'],'CYS':['CB','SG'],'VAL':['CB','CG1','CG2']}
AX={'ARG':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3),('CD','NE',4)],
    'LYS':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3),('CD','CE',4)],
    'GLU':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3)],'GLN':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3)],
    'ASP':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],'ASN':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],'MET':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','SD',3)],
    'LEU':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],'ILE':[('CA','CB',1),('CG1','CD1',3)],'HIS':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],
    'PHE':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],'TYR':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],'TRP':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2)],
    'SER':[('CA','CB',1)],'THR':[('CA','CB',1)],'CYS':[('CA','CB',1)],'VAL':[('CA','CB',1)]}

PY=parse(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text,chain='A')
rP=PY['res']; bb=['N','CA','C','O']; pl_P=list(range(212,225))
P=np.array([rP[i]['atoms'][a] for i in pl_P for a in bb])
ptr=np.array([h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and not h[3].startswith('H')])

GRP={}
for g in ['AVLIMC','FWY','STNQ','DE','KRH','GP']:
    for c in g: GRP[c]=g
def sc(a,b): return 3 if a==b else (1 if GRP.get(a)==GRP.get(b) else -2)

targets=[('SDF-9','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',None,220),
         ('IA-2/PTPRN','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2I1Y.pdb','A',None),
         ('IA-2b/PTPRN2','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2QEP.pdb','A',None),
         ('STYX','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8WUJ0-F1-model_v6.pdb',None,None),
         ('PTP1B apo','https://files.rcsb.org/download/1SUG.pdb','A',None)]
res_rows=[]
for name,url,ch,forced in targets:
    T=parse(requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=150).text,chain=ch); rT=T['res']
    order=[i for i in T['order'] if all(a in rT[i]['atoms'] for a in bb)]
    if forced is None:
        seqP=''.join(AA3[rP[i]['rn']] for i in pl_P); seqT=''.join(AA3[rT[i]['rn']] for i in order)
        best=sorted(((sum(sc(a,b) for a,b in zip(seqP,seqT[k:k+13])),k) for k in range(len(seqT)-12)),reverse=True)
        win=order[best[0][1]:best[0][1]+13]
    else:
        win=list(range(forced,forced+13))      # SDF-9 registration from structural superposition + PRINTS, iteration 1
    S=np.array([rT[i]['atoms'][a] for i in win for a in bb])
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(S,P)
    toS=lambda Y:(Y-qc)@R.T+pc
    ligS=np.array([toS(p) for p in ptr])
    # which residues block the ligand
    block={}
    for ri,rv in rT.items():
        for nm,x in rv['atoms'].items():
            if np.linalg.norm(ligS-x,axis=1).min()<2.6: block[ri]=block.get(ri,0)+1
    movable=[ri for ri in block if rT[ri]['rn'] in AX and any(nm not in ('N','CA','C','O','CB') for nm in rT[ri]['atoms'])]
    out=[]
    for ri in sorted(movable,key=lambda i:-block[i])[:3]:
        rv=rT[ri]; rn=rv['rn']; names=[n for n in SC[rn] if n in rv['atoms']]
        if not names: continue
        env=[]
        CB=rv['atoms'].get('CB',rv['atoms']['CA'])
        for rj,r2 in rT.items():
            if rj==ri: continue
            for nm,x in r2['atoms'].items():
                if abs(rj-ri)<=1 and nm not in ('N','CA','C','O'): continue
                if np.linalg.norm(x-CB)<14: env.append(x)
        env=np.array(env)
        chis=[c for c in AX[rn] if c[0] in rv['atoms'] and c[1] in rv['atoms']]
        angs=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,8,endpoint=False)
        allowed=free=0
        for combo in itertools.product(angs,repeat=len(chis)):
            pos={n:rv['atoms'][n].copy() for n in names}
            for (a,b,st),ang in zip(chis,combo):
                A=pos.get(a,rv['atoms'][a]); B=pos[b]
                mv=[n for n in SC[rn][SC[rn].index(b)+1:] if n in pos] if b!='CB' else [n for n in names if n!='CB']
                if b=='CB': mv=[n for n in names if n!='CB']
                if not mv: continue
                arr=rot(A,B,ang,np.array([pos[n] for n in mv]))
                for n,x in zip(mv,arr): pos[n]=x
            X=np.array([pos[n] for n in names])
            if np.linalg.norm(env[None]-X[:,None],axis=2).min()<3.0: continue
            allowed+=1
            if np.linalg.norm(ligS[None]-X[:,None],axis=2).min()>=3.0: free+=1
        pct=100*free/max(allowed,1)
        out.append((rn+str(ri),block[ri],allowed,free,pct))
        print(f'{name:13s} blocker {rn}{ri} ({block[ri]} clashing atoms): {allowed} allowed rotamers, {free} clear of pTyr ({pct:.0f}%)')
    res_rows.append((name,out))
print()
for name,out in res_rows:
    if out: print(name,'-> best relief among top blockers: %.0f%%'%max(o[4] for o in out))
    else: print(name,'-> no movable blocking side chain')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.2))
labs=[];vals=[];cols=[]
for name,out in res_rows:
    labs.append(name); v=max([o[4] for o in out],default=100.0); vals.append(v)
    cols.append('firebrick' if v<5 else 'steelblue')
ax.bar(labs,vals,color=cols)
ax.set_ylabel('% of allowed rotamers that clear the pTyr site')
ax.set_title('Can the pocket-blocking side chain move out of the way?')
ax.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=20,labelsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1.5,f'{v:.0f}%',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
